title: DS Roundtable 2: The Setup is Flawless, The Direction is Unclear

excerpts.label: Microsoft -30% is buyable
excerpts.insight: Quality tech down 30% into support—you can't not own Microsoft at these levels
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY MSFT -30%. Dip-buyers rotating back into quality. Rare opportunity in unbeatable brand that's been capital-light for decades. Size appropriately—indices capped 7,200 not 7,700.

excerpts.label: Buybacks canceled = structural negative
excerpts.insight: Meta canceled Q4 repurchases, Google cut 67%—removes price-insensitive buyer for entire market
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE. When Apple buybacks happen, sellers reinvest in SPY not AAPL. Billions in support removed. Monitor equity multiple compression. Favor stocks with intact buyback programs.

excerpts.label: Crypto put in capitulation low
excerpts.insight: BTC 68k—largest flush in years without FTX-type external crisis event
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY BTC/IBIT. Clean technical capitulation (largest down-days without major event = different psychology). 69420 fill worked. Crypto bottoming often precedes broader risk asset lows.

excerpts.label: Friday rally was technical not fundamental
excerpts.insight: 200-handle SPY rip had zero news catalyst—purely technical bounce off support
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE if no retrace. Gap-and-goes need confirmation. Watch for B-wave back to 68.50 opening swings. Only ice-cold CPI can fuel real breakout from here. VIX >18 = rally not confirmed.

excerpts.label: Japan yen breaking 160 like butter
excerpts.insight: If BOJ doesn't hike during stimulus unleashed by tonight's election, yen cuts through 160 consensus level
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HEDGE via Treasuries. Japan contagion risk real—LDP supermajority → stimulus → BOJ can't hike fast enough → JGB selloff bleeds to UST. They own lot of US bonds. Prior events needed Fed intervention.

excerpts.label: Curve steepeners alive despite Worsh
excerpts.insight: 2s10s closed steepest in range—Worsh pick was supposed to flatten curve but didn't
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS NOW. Backend can go 20bps more. Long SOFR H7 (rolled from H6 after POW killed near-term cuts). Watch ZN 116 threshold. Fed neutered—tweener data now hard no vs. previous 'defer to easy.'

excerpts.label: Gold -20% washed out speculators
excerpts.insight: Parabolic flush to 44-45 old highs held, making higher lows—time consolidation needed
excerpts.pm_takeaway: GOLD DCA 44-45 zone for long-term. Don't chase ATH retests. 20%+ flush removed excess speculators—healthy base forming. Expect 500-800 range chop. Debasement hedge over very long term.
